requirements.requirement: The system must define a provenance metadata schema containing fields: source_type, source_name, api_endpoint, dataset_id, retrieval_timestamp, and version.
The system must enforce that all provenance fields are present in the schema definition as required fields.
The system must define source_type as an enumerated value (e.g., API, dataset, computed, manual).
The system must define retrieval_timestamp in ISO 8601 UTC format.
The system must define api_endpoint as a string that supports null only when source_type is not API.
The system must define dataset_id as a string identifier for the upstream dataset or API resource.
The system must define version as a string representing the version of the source dataset or API schema.
The system must define a contract such that every quality measure object includes a provenance metadata object as a nested field.
The system must ensure the provenance schema is serializable in JSON without loss of field fidelity.
The system must ensure backward compatibility by allowing existing measure objects to be extended with provenance without breaking existing fields.
The system must validate that retrieval_timestamp is not in the future at the time of object creation.
The system must validate that source_name is a non-empty string.
The system must provide a schema definition accessible to all evaluation services via a shared module.
The system must document the provenance schema contract for downstream consumers including required and optional fields.
The system must fail validation when any required provenance field is missing.
The system must fail validation when source_type contains a value outside the defined enumeration.
The system must allow version to be null only when the upstream source does not provide versioning.
The system must ensure that provenance metadata can be programmatically attached to any measure object without requiring transformation of the measure structure.
The system must ensure that provenance schema supports extension with additional fields without breaking existing contract.
The system must ensure that all provenance field names follow consistent snake_case naming conventions.
